marta: Heads-up  final battlecard copy needed for Thursday webinar + launch posts. Focus: cloud AI platforms, LLM API providers, infra vendors. We need: 3 punchy claims with 1-line proof each, 2 SDR inbound hooks, and one webinar slide. Can we finish today?

shannon: Suggest claim / evidence / customer impact. Short. Example: 'Predictable inference economics' / 'reserved pools + batching typically cut token cost ~20-40%' / 'lower cost per conversation.'

ana: Agree. Keep all proofs product-first (no competitor names). Use Dedicated SLA, Private VPC, per-route cost analytics as proof points.

ana: Draft claims: 
1) "Predictable production performance across hosted, dedicated, private"  proof: "SLA-backed dedicated pools + smart routing with automatic fallbacks." 
2) "Lower cost per conversation for chat workloads"  proof: "continuous batching + KV prefix caching and Optimize recommendations." 
3) "Enterprise controls without a full infra rewrite"  proof: "Private control plane, KMS/HSM, audit logs, on-prem option."

priya: For the webinar, pair each claim with a common objection and a 1-line rebuttal. Ex: Objection: 'Cloud vendor has scale' -> Rebuttal: 'Scale alone doesn't deliver predictable latency or cost; our routing + reserved pools do.'

shannon: Add a defensible metric: "Internal chat benchmark (mixed contexts): dedicated pools + batching gave typical 20-40% token-cost savings and improved median latency vs shared-hosted baseline." Frame as typical, not guaranteed.

marta: SDR routing hooks (short): 
- Cloud AI leads: "Want predictable latency & cost beyond raw capacity? We have a 1-page economics comp."
- LLM API leads: "Need rollout control and private deploys? 30m demo of Dedicated + Private."
- Infra vendor leads: "Want runtime control without hiring an infra team? We combine runtime controls with ops tooling and SLAs."

priya: Email subject ABs: 
A1: "Production-grade LLM inference without re-architecting your stack"
A2: "Reduce inference cost and guarantee latency  30m demo"
B1: "Benchmarks that matter: latency, cost, enterprise controls"
B2: "Stop trading reliability for cost: predictable inference"

shannon: One-pager structure: claims (3), two-line proofs, top 4 rebuttals, routing hooks, anonymous customer soundbite. Keep it skimmable.

marta: @ana can you draft the single-slide one-pager by EOD? We need to hand to SDR lead tonight.

ana: I'll draft now and post a link: https://redwood.internal/briefs/ops-econ-bc-draft.

priya: I'll map routing triggers and add 3 quick SDR scripts + an escalation checklist (scripts 1-2 lines each).

devops-bot: Reminder: webinar landing page deploy scheduled 2026-04-02T16:00Z; CI smoke tests at 03:30 UTC.

marta: Final checklist: Ana one-pager by EOD, marketing social hooks (I'll draft), SDR routing confirmation (Priya), legal claims review (I'll ping). Review at 4pm PT. :thumbsup:
